decisions.reason: The dismantling joint sits at the core of the firm's water and pipeline business, it was promoted from a website mention to a page of its own, and it uses existing fabrication skills, so the firm is strongly committed and has little reason to withdraw it.

Although the waste bin is far from the core business, the firm has invested in powder-coating capacity and publicly presented it as a diversification, so management is likely to blame weak results on temporary causes such as the pandemic hitting municipal budgets and keep it.

As a multi-model line using the firm's coating equipment, it represents a visible commitment and design investment that management would want to justify, even though it is distant from the core offer.

The outdoor ashtray line belongs to the same publicly announced street-furniture move and shares sunk investment with the bins, so the firm would likely persist while hoping municipal demand recovers.
